final: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity),'') AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) * 1.0 / SUM(derived_total_cost) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS o FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_qty, inv.cost_ratio, inv.avg_qty - overall.o AS diff_above_overall FROM inv, overall WHERE inv.avg_qty > overall.o ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10
